behavior: No safe executable move ends the board without a winner or letter replacement in every mode
CPU retains its search animation before a neutral end
Neutral rounds preserve wins/streak and increment played once
NEXT carries points, panels, alternatives and elapsed time unless the player lost
Player loss shows final total; NEXT resets. Explicit replay/new start is a separate zero-score run
Reload and failed-board retry preserve totals; prior hints/reference remain classified
One ranking snapshot per attempt/category; legacy single-board ranks remain accessible separately

scale.note: Controlled fixture checks cumulative arithmetic and bounded state, not 100 human-played matches.

ui.notes: Includes current result layout, continuation/reload, loss/reset, old rankings, hint classification, error retry, full 4096 picture decodes per engine, and existing game regressions.

resolvedEarlierChecks: The first scoped suite exposed a test fixture that depended on automatic letter replacement; replaced it with a real safe route.
Before the final result layout, 267/270 UI cases passed; three obsolete victory-heading assertions were updated to assert the neutral result and exact reducer winner.
Two final Firefox cases exposed prefetch-before-fault and an insufficient CPU reveal wait; six focused cases across all engines passed after correcting the test setup on the same runtime.
Initial core coverage was 87.95%; added legacy save/timer/replay/pause behavior tests and reached 90.72% without lowering the threshold.
limitations: Desktop browser automation and viewport resizing, not physical iOS/Android devices or OS keyboard tests.
Audio playback was not auditioned through a speaker.
Scores/rankings are local to this browser origin; LAN sharing of rankings is not provided.
Earlier release ZIPs remain the original release; the active dist/LAN game contains this update.
